text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hardening their heart, the Trainer informs 
K.S. Miracle that they are withdrawing 
from the Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She wishes to repay all the kindness and 
miracles she has received so far. Though 
it is a harsh decision for someone with 
that wish, it is also for the sake of her 
future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then, watching the Sprinters Stakes in 
despair, K.S. Miracle loses consciousness. 
No matter how many times she is called out 
to, she does not wake up.
